entities.name: Zaan al-Murad
entities.description: A brilliant scientist and genius who becomes a cursed figure, seeking peace but plagued by the loss of loved ones and forbidden resurrection science.
entities.quote: Zaan al-Murad (nickname: The Cursed Prodigy) Age: 26 Appearance: Once considered the most handsome man of his generation. Tall, sharp-jawed, with intense eyes.

entities.name: Raisa bint Khalid
entities.description: Zaan's first love and a brilliant student of science who helps him in his forbidden rituals before ultimately dying trying to help him.
entities.quote: Zaan’s first love, the only one who ever entered his lab and stood beside him in a divine scientific ritual.

entities.name: Shina Nasrin
entities.description: A gentle, humble woman who falls in love with Zaan while living in hiding and is ultimately murdered by villagers.
entities.quote: Unmarried pregnant woman who was taken in by Grandma Aysha. Eventually falls in love with Zaan, who accepts her and her unborn child.

entities.name: Ayesha Khatoon
entities.description: An elderly, wise, and fierce woman who provides shelter to Zaan and Shina, acting as a maternal figure.
entities.quote: Treated Zaan as her son from the start, knowing he wasn’t Yousuf. Final Fate: Brutally murdered by villagers.

entities.name: Rahim Ibn Suleiman
entities.description: A patient and selfless man originally arranged to marry Raisa, who offers emotional support.
entities.quote: The man Raisa was arranged to marry. Though he resembled Zaan slightly in voice and manner, he never tried to "replace" Zaan.

entities.name: Mizan
entities.description: A village boy who initially supported Zaan but later betrayed and killed Shina out of fear and mob mentality.
entities.quote: Final Turn: Betrayed and stabbed Shina and Grandma due to fear, manipulated by the mob mentality.

entities.name: Raijan
entities.description: A village boy who initially supported Zaan but eventually turned against him due to mob mentality.
entities.quote: Final Turn: Betrayed and stabbed Shina and Grandma due to fear, manipulated by the mob mentality.

entities.name: Imperial Institute of Advanced Sciences
entities.description: The prestigious scientific institute in Hayrabad where Zaan and Raisa conducted their initial studies.
entities.quote: Among the most prestigious of these institutions was The Imperial Institute of Advanced Sciences — a place where only the brightest, most privileged minds dared to enter.

entities.name: Ottoman Guards
entities.description: Military forces representing the empire's law, frequently hunting Zaan due to his forbidden scientific research.
entities.quote: Represent law, order, and silence. They aren’t entirely evil—but they are products of a broken empire trying to retain control.

timeline_events.title: The First Revival Experiment
timeline_events.description: Zaan and Raisa attempt to revive a deceased criminal, resulting in an explosion that burns Zaan and kills him briefly before he awakens.
timeline_events.quote: Zaan adjusted the levers, his voice tense but steady: "Tonight, we attempt to seize what no man has seized. To reverse God’s decree."
